title: Create and recover your own personal token.
text: Run yoke tokens create --name LABEL from a personal terminal, or choose Profile → API tokens → New token. Copy the value once; yoke tokens list exposes metadata only. Lost output or result_unavailable means revoke its ID with yoke tokens revoke TOKEN-ID and create another token. Use --token-stdin or --token-file PATH for an intentional token connection. A token acts as its creator and cannot admit a teammate as a new person. Local tokens work on this computer only; sharing requires yoke self-host init. Retire a machine to revoke its machine-bound credentials.
verification: CLI and Profile source tests cover personal authority, one-time output and revoke/create recovery. Published-wheel and deployed proof remain owed.
